name: Front
summary: Customer communication platform built on shared inboxes across email, SMS and chat. For agents: a hosted MCP server at mcp.frontapp.com/mcp (OAuth 2.1 + PKCE, no Dynamic Client Registration; scopes read, write, send) whose create_draft tool queues a reply for human review without sending, beside read tools for the full conversation. Front's own guide puts the reply-writing in an externally hosted assistant, not Front.

payments.notes: Reached with a Front teammate's OAuth token; the docs name no separate MCP charge. front.com/pricing lists seat-based plans but renders prices behind script I did not pin, so no per-plan figure is quoted and humanBilling stays unknown. Not machine-payable.

agentAccess.notes: Keyless initialize POST to mcp.frontapp.com/mcp answered 401 (2026-11-13 06:08Z) with a Bearer challenge; resource metadata names auth server app.frontapp.com, scope feature:mcp. No keyless path: needs a Front account and a confidential OAuth app, no Dynamic Client Registration. No tool called.

jobs.summary: create_draft: "Creates a draft reply on an existing conversation, or a new outbound conversation. Does not send." The AI-agents guide puts the reply-writing in an agent "hosted external to Front". Edit distance, handle time and CSAT: no vendor figure.
